description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取基金经理任期内的持股汇总数据。可按基金经理代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回日期、持股市值、持股数量、持股占净值比、股票代码等数据。当用户想了解基金经理任期内的持仓风格或选股偏好时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain major shareholding data during a fund manager's tenure. Filters can be applied by fund manager code and date range, returning fields such as date, market value of holdings, number of shares held, holding as percentage of net value, and stock code. Call this interface when users want to understand the holding style during a fund manager's tenure or which stocks they prefer.

params.name: token
descriptions: 我的Token页有用户专属且唯一的Token。

params.name: stockCode
constraints: 请参考基金信息API获取合法的stockCode。

params.name: startDate
descriptions: 用于获取一定时间范围内的数据。
constraints: 开始和结束的时间间隔不超过10年

params.name: endDate
descriptions: 结束信息日期。用于获取时间范围内的数据，默认值为今天结束。

requestExample.desc: 示例1: 通过时间范围获取
